title: I’ve just … · I’ve already … · I haven’t … yet (present perfect 2)

exercises.instruction: Для каждой картинки напишите предложение с just.

answers: They have just bought a car

exercises.instruction: Закончите предложения. Используйте already + present perfect.

parts:
Do your friends want to see the film?
No, they

Don’t forget to phone Tom.
I

When is Mark going away?
He

Do you want to read the newspaper?
I

When does Sarah start her new job?
She

exercises.instruction: Напишите утвердительное предложение с just (They’ve just … / She’s just … и т. д.) или отрицательное предложение с yet (They haven’t … yet / She hasn’t … yet и т. д.).

answers: They have just finished their dinner.

items.prompt: Your friend has a new job. Perhaps she has started it. You ask her:
answers: Have you started your new job yet?

items.prompt: Your friend has some new neighbours. Perhaps he has met them. You ask him:
answers: Have you met your new neighbours yet?

items.prompt: Your friend has to pay her electricity bill. Perhaps she has paid it. You ask her:
answers: Have you paid your electricity bill yet?

items.prompt: Tom was crying to sell his car. Perhaps he has sold it. You ask a friend about Tom:
answers: Has Tom sold his car yet?
Has he sold his car yet?

items.prompt: Антон и Марина только что купили новый дом.
answers: Anton and Marina have just bought a new house.
Has Sandra called her mother yet?

items.prompt:
A: Джеймс здесь?
B: Нет, он уже ушёл.
answers: ‘Is James here?’ ‘No, he has already gone.’
‘Is James here?’ ‘No, he has already left.’

items.prompt:
A: Тебе нравится эта книга?
B: Я не знаю. Я её ещё не читал.
answers:
A: Do you like this book?
B: I don’t know. I haven’t read it yet.

A: Do you like this book?
B: I don’t know. I have not read it yet.

A: Do you like this book?
B: I do not know. I haven’t read it yet.

A: Do you like this book?
B: I do not know. I have not read it yet.

items.prompt:
A: Не забудь закрыть окна!
B: Я их уже закрыл.
answers: ‘Don’t forget to close the windows.’ ‘I’ve already closed them.’
